description: The image shows the logo for the European Environment Agency (EEA). The logo consists of a circular graphic symbol split vertically. The left half of the circle depicts several green, leaf-like or petal-like elements arranged radially, suggesting natural growth. The right half of the circle depicts a blue gear-like cogwheel structure, suggesting industry or mechanics. To the right of the graphic, the black text "European Environment Agency" is stacked vertically across three lines.
